subject: ZenithCare: Attestation gap — supplemental control artifacts and timeframe confirmation
messages:
From: Dana Lopez <dana.lopez@zenithcare.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mark Ellis <mark.ellis@zenithcare.com>, ZenithCare Security <security@zenithcare.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Attestation gap + request for supplemental artifacts

Hi Sean —

Thanks again for sending your SOC 2 Type II report. Our audit team reviewed the attestation and identified a small coverage gap relative to our audit window (our procurement/infosec team requires coverage through 2026-08-31). To move forward with our vendor review and signoff we need the following supplemental items tied back to the SOC 2 controls:

- Confirmation of the audit period covered by the report and (if applicable) a brief attestation/bridge letter that explains any gap and compensating controls.
- A time-bound sample (CSV) of authentication/access events that support CC6/IA sections: MFA enforcement events and successful/failed logins for a scoped 7‑day slice within the audit period. IPs may be redacted.
- Results of the most recent privileged access review (a roll‑up PDF and list of users removed or changed).
- Evidence of KMS/key rotation for the past 12 months (rotation dates + DocID/reference).

Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide those artifacts by EOD Tuesday next week? Also, please indicate if any of this requires an NDA or a secure transfer method — our security team prefers shared Drive with view-only links or an SFTP drop.

Thanks — we want to get this through charting ASAP.

Best,
Dana Lopez
Sr. Security & Privacy Manager
ZenithCare

Attachment: ZenithCare-Evidence-Checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Dana Lopez <dana.lopez@zenithcare.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Attestation gap + request for supplemental artifacts

Hi Dana —

Thanks for the clear list. We can provide the items you requested. Quick clarifying points so we scope precisely:

1) Audit window: our SOC 2 Type II period is 2025-09-01 through 2026-07-31. We recognize that leaves a gap to your preferred 2026-08-31 date; we can provide a bridge letter that explains the gap and calls out compensating controls and monitoring we've had in the interim.

2) Auth log slice: we propose extracting a 7‑day sample from 2026-07-24 to 2026-07-30 (end of our covered period) to demonstrate MFA enforcement and login events. If you prefer a sample later in August, note that those events fall outside the attested period — our bridge letter will need to reference that explicitly.

3) Privileged access review: we can deliver a redacted roll‑up PDF and a CSV of accounts changed in the last quarter.

4) KMS evidence: we will include rotation metadata (dates and key IDs) and the rotation runbook reference.

For transfer, Redwood can share a view-only Drive folder (recommended) and we can also provide an SFTP link if your team prefers. We will redact IP addresses and any user PII as standard practice.

Do these deliverables and the 7‑day sample window work for your auditors? If so, we’ll assemble the package and provide a Drive link and a draft attestation/bridge letter for your records.

Next step: I’ll coordinate with Marissa and Ben to pull the slices and have a prod-ready package by Tue 2026-09-15 EOD PT.

—Sean
Sean Gallagher
Head of Customer Security Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: none

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2026 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Attestation gap + request for supplemental artifacts

Sean —

I can pull the auth log slice from our centralized logging index. Path: s3://redwood-logs/auth/2026/07/24-07-30/*. We will redact IPs and truncate any session tokens. The CSV will include: timestamp, user_id (hashed), action (login_success/login_failure/mfa_challenge), device_agent (partial), region. Estimated size is ~12MB compressed.

Privileged access rollup: I'll generate the PDF that summarizes the quarterly review and attach the raw csv of user changes (columns: user_email, previous_role, new_role, change_date, approver).

KMS rotation proof: operations has key rotation entries in Vault with audit IDs; I’ll export the rotation dates and link to the runbook doc.

I’ll push artifacts into a secure Drive folder and flag the main link to Sean when ready. Ben, please confirm there are no outstanding retention holds on the auth slices for that timeframe.

—Marissa

Attachment: internal-runbook-ref.txt (stub)

From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Dana Lopez <dana.lopez@zenithcare.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Mark Ellis <mark.ellis@zenithcare.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 16:30:00 -07:00
Subject: ZenithCare supplemental artifacts and attestation note (delivery)

Dana / Mark —

Per our plan, we uploaded the requested artifacts to a view-only Drive folder and included a short attestation note describing the audit period gap and compensating controls: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-zenith-evidence.

Package contents (redacted where indicated):
- scoped-auth-log-sample.csv (7-day slice 2026-07-24 -> 2026-07-30) — includes hashed user IDs and redacted IPs.
- access-review-rollup.pdf — quarterly privileged access review summary (PDF).
- ksm_rotation_evidence.csv — key IDs and rotation dates for previous 12 months.
- attestation-gap-bridge-letter.pdf — short letter explaining audit coverage (SOC period 2025-09-01 -> 2026-07-31) and the monitoring/alerting in place since 2026-08-01.

Notes and caveats:
- The auth slice falls inside the SOC period; we explicitly called out in the bridge letter any monitoring since July 31 that we believe is relevant.
- IPs stripped per your request. If auditors require raw IPs under a data sharing agreement, we can discuss secure transfer options and an NDA amendment.

Please confirm receipt and whether this package satisfies your audit queue. If you need a different 7-day window in August (outside our attested period) we can extract that as well but will annotate it as outside the SOC 2 coverage.

Thanks — looking forward to the signoff.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Head of Customer Security Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: scoped-auth-log-sample.csv (CSV stub), access-review-rollup.pdf (PDF stub), attestation-gap-bridge-letter.pdf (PDF stub)
